Comment: Required VPC DNS settings for Route 53 private hosted zones

EnableDnsSupport.Description: Enables DNS resolution via Route 53 Resolver at VPC+2 address

EnableDnsHostnames.Description: Assigns public DNS hostnames to instances with public IPs

DhcpOptionsSet.Description: Uses Route 53 Resolver for DNS queries

Notes: Both EnableDnsSupport and EnableDnsHostnames must be true for private hosted zones
VPC DNS resolver is automatically available at VPC CIDR base + 2 (e.g., 10.0.0.2)
Changes to DNS settings take effect immediately for new instances
Existing instances may need to renew DHCP lease or reboot
